description: [wallet-required, $0.001/call] End-of-day US equity quote: last close, day range, previous close and the change between them. US equities only; indices, FX and crypto are not covered (crypto-price serves those). Built from a four-venue consolidation (Databento DBEQ.BASIC), so the prices track the wider market but the volume counts those four venues only and is returned as venueVolume rather than as a total. No 52-week range and no intraday print: for a date range call stock-history. Returns { symbol, currency, price, previousClose, changeAbs, changePct, dayHigh, dayLow }. This hosted connector holds no wallet: pay it here over MPP, or run npx agent402-mcp with a funded wallet (AGENT_KEY) or prepaid card credits (AGENT402_CREDITS_KEY), or any x402 client.

symbol.description: US equity ticker, e.g. AAPL. Indices, FX and crypto are not covered.
